subject: ACME - Context length & pricing follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@acme.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: ACME - Context length & pricing follow-up

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap + a few follow-up questions so we can do an accurate pricing profile for the pilot: 

Recap
- Primary use case: long-form summarization + assisted authoring for product docs and R&D notes.
- Typical flow: retrieve ~1-10 long docs, concatenate + few-shot prompt, ask for extractive + abstractive summary.
- Hard requirement: occasional very long contexts (32k) and rare cases where full-archive context (~128k) would be ideal for one-off runs.

Profiling details we discussed (ask: please confirm / correct):
- Avg prompt tokens: ~350 tokens (prompt + context before model).
- Avg completion tokens: ~900 tokens (long summaries + follow-ups).
- Avg tokens per call: ~1,250 tokens.
- Context-length split (estimate): 70% 8k, 25% 32k, 5% 128k.

Token-volume & budget signals (we discussed ranges):
- Expected pilot monthly volume (best guess on call): ~30-50M total tokens.
- Budget range you mentioned: $10k- $30k/month for pilot + early production.
- Target unit economics you mentioned on the call: target in the range of $10- $15 per 1M tokens (please confirm).

Next steps from Redwood side
1) If you can send 1-2 representative prompts + a small set of example docs (or anonymized excerpts), we’ll run a profiling pass to validate average prompt/completion tokens and context util. I attached a token-profile template for quick upload.
2) I’ll produce a short pricing estimator showing cost ranges for 8k/32k/128k variants and a recommended pilot config (batching, KV cache settings, quantization suggestions).
3) If the numbers look reasonable, we can schedule a 30-min pilot setup to run 48-72 hour profiling on your sample payloads.

A couple clarifying Qs:
- Is the $10k- $30k/month the total spend ceiling or the monthly credit you’d allocate to the pilot specifically?
- Do you have any hard SLA/latency constraints for the summaries (p90 < 1s vs p90 < 3s matters for instance sizing)?

I’ll draft a ballpark for the 3 context tiers and share once you confirm the numbers above.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment: acme_token_profile.csv (token-profile template)

From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Sep 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME - Context length & pricing follow-up

Hey Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming / refining the numbers from our side after chatting with the product team: 

Usage profile (more precise):
- Avg prompt tokens: 400 (this includes retrieved doc snippets; we may be conservative on prompt size).
- Avg completion tokens: 850.
- Avg tokens per call: ~1,250 (your number lines up well).
- Monthly expected volume (pilot -> Q1): 35M total tokens (we’d expect growth to ~120M in 6-9 months if things go well).

Context-length breakdown (we ran a quick log sample):
- 8k: ~68% of calls
- 32k: ~27%
- 128k: ~5% (these are mostly batch offline jobs, not latency-sensitive)

Budget & unit economics
- For the pilot: we can allocate up to $20k/month.
- Longer-term target: we’d like to keep unit costs under $12 per 1M tokens if quality is maintained. That’s not a hard ceiling but the economics we’re aiming for.

SLA
- Latency: for interactive flows (most of the 8k/32k calls) p90 target ~2s. For the 128k offline runs, latency is not critical.

I’ve attached a small CSV export of sampled requests (anonymized) - it’s the token_profile: acme_token_profile.csv. Jordan on my side is going to coordinate procurement. Looping Leah (procurement) for contract steps / PO.

Thanks — happy to jump on a short call if you want to run through samples together.

Sam
Sam Patel
Director, NLP Platforms | ACME Corp
sam.patel@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 03 Sep 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME - Context length & pricing follow-up

Sam - great, thanks for the clarified numbers and for the sample CSV. That gives us enough to run a preliminary cost model. 

Ballpark estimator (pilot, monthly, based on provided profile):
- Assumptions: 35M tokens total / month; avg tokens per call ~1,250; context-split 68/27/5.
- Ballpark pricing ranges (per 1M tokens) we’d show to procurement for initial discussion:
  - 8k model variant: $14- $18 / 1M tokens
  - 32k model variant: $18- $24 / 1M tokens
  - 128k model variant (infrequent offline): $30- $45 / 1M tokens
- Estimated pilot spend range (monthly): $12k- $22k depending on how many 32k/128k runs we classify as "interactive" vs "batch".

Recommendations / next steps
1) We’ll run a 72-hour profiling job with your attached sample payloads (need your ok). Profiling will produce: observed avg prompt/completion tokens, tail latency breakdown, and a recommended config (batch size, KV cache TTL, quantization profile).
2) I’ll send a short pricing summary doc (PDF) that maps your monthly volume to expected spend under each context profile and shows an optimized configuration that targets ~$12 / 1M tokens effective unit cost. (Attaching an early draft: redwood_pricing_estimate_v2.pdf)
3) If that looks good to Leah/procurement, we can spin up a time-limited pilot environment (dedicated pilot pool) and provide invoiceable consumption tracking.

Please confirm: we have permission to run the profiling pass on the attached CSV and to share the pricing estimator with procurement (Leah). Also confirm the $20k/month pilot ceiling.

If you’d like, I can schedule a 30-min checkpoint next Tue to review the profiler output.

Thanks,
Marissa
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood_pricing_estimate_v2.pdf
